create_cooldown_cache: create a CooldownCache instance with a DualCache backend and default cooldown time in seconds
add_deployment_to_cooldown: add a model deployment to cooldown after an exception with optional custom cooldown duration
get_active_cooldowns: get all active cooldowns for a list of model IDs from the cache synchronously
async_get_active_cooldowns: async get all active cooldowns for a list of model IDs from the cache with OpenTelemetry span support
get_min_cooldown: get the minimum cooldown time required across a group of model IDs
